exposure: Listening to patient's own choice music during cesarean section
Listening to Acemashiran maqam music during cesarean section
outcome: Amount of postoperative PCA medication leftover
Patient desire for music in future cesarean sections
cohort: 92 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section under regional anesthesia.
finding: Listening to music, particularly in the Acemashiran maqam, reduced intraoperative pain during cesarean sections, with Acemashiran maqam music showing a more pronounced effect than patient's own choice music.
mod_finding: Listening to music during cesarean sections under regional anesthesia was found to reduce intraoperative pain, with a specific type of music (Acemashiran maqam) being more effective than the patient's own choice.
